newsitem.title: USA: Ceridian names Turner to management team.
newsitem.headline: Ceridian names Turner to management team.

text.p: Ceridian Corp said Tuesday it named Ronald Turner executive vice president of operations, effective immediately.
The company said Turner, who had been president and chief executive officer of its Computing Devices International business, will focus on day-to-day operations management.
The new assignment will enable Lawrence Perlman, Ceridian's chief executive officer, to devote his time to strategy development and revenue growth, the company said.
Ceridian said it will name a new president for its Computing Devices International shortly.
Ceridian is an information services and defense electronics company. Its shares closed off one Tuesday at 34-1/2.
